description: This file defines an enumeration 'LocalizedFormats' used for managing localized message formats in exception handling within the Apache Commons Math library. It includes constants for various error message templates, methods for retrieving source and localized strings, and handles resource bundle loading for localization.

classes.name: LocalizedFormats
classes.description: An enum implementing Localizable, representing various message formats for exception localization.

methods.name: getSourceString
methods.description: Returns the English source format string for the enum constant.

methods.name: getLocalizedString
methods.description: Retrieves the localized message format string based on the provided Locale, falling back to the source string if localization is unavailable.
